page: Microsoft Azure EC48ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9V74 processor, the configuration provides 48 dedicated vCPUs distributed across 24 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. It provides 384 GB of total system RAM, establishing an 8 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. Hardware vector instructions include AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16 extensions, alongside hardware-accelerated cryptographic primitives including AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Storage provisions consist of 1933 GB of integrated local solid-state storage with support for Premium Storage tiers. The instance operates without discrete GPU accelerators and allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Benchmark assessments record strong processor performance, reaching 3023.15 in stress-ng single-core tests and 72060.43 in multi-core tests, placing compute throughput in the top 25 percent. In-memory data store tests show middle-tier performance, producing 60.57 million Redis SET operations per second.

The dense memory footprint combined with direct local SSD capacity provides solid resource efficiency for high-density transactional environments. The large local storage tier mitigates network input and output bottlenecks for intermediate data storage. These characteristics make the EC48ads_v6 well suited for enterprise relational databases, distributed in-memory data grids, caching tiers, and large-scale data transformation pipelines.
